scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Candidate 03 is the only candidate passing all hard gates, and mask-only review shows coherent significant tumor-boundary expansion with complete quota and preserved surrounding structures.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 71,091-pixel tumor expansion follows the existing external tumor-stroma interfaces in connected planned regions and preserves neighboring immune and non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Twenty-three class-1 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, instance-count, NND and Ripley K24 ratios are 1.054, 1.218, 0.929 and 0.721, respectively, within the frozen envelope.
decisions.coupling: Added tumor nuclei occupy the authorized expanded tumor footprint; boundary binding, seam continuity, quota, compatibility, spatial-distribution and local-density gates pass, with sampling score 0.891.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and native structures outside joint support remain unchanged, without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target is more numerous and more regularly spaced than the source distribution, although within frozen hard limits. This mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality, histologic truth or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff.
